END, slots 257 and 257b, light (dc, Utilz, todo 18), on vc's GOs by socket at 20:33Z and 20:37Z, bytes as vc hashed them (kv-readback.sh c0e7bf15, kv-readback-remote.sh 23e128a2, kv-rm-tooldirs.sh d72ba621): 2.14.2's keg on kovacs reads right on every row in both runs, and the keg wrote nothing under $HOME; each outside FAIL is another writer's, named by that writer's own record. dc's two /var/tmp tool dirs on kovacs are removed.
- Run 1, rb2142, 20:34:00Z to 20:34:20Z: 83 ok, 7 note, 1 FAIL. Run 2, rb2142b, 20:37:54Z to 20:38:09Z, started once the Mac's load read 59.07: 83 ok, 9 note, 10 FAIL. Every row but outside is ok in both and identical across the two. Logs in ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-dc/readback/rb2142/logs/ and rb2142b/logs/; both kovacs run dirs removed.
- The keg: brew list utilz 2.14.2 and yq 4.54.1; utilz:2.14.2 installed at /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/Cellar/utilz/2.14.2/libexec (54b6262, CI unknown), the only utilz on the login PATH; utilz doctor "All checks passed!" exit 0, with its macOS-only rows; each refusal 0083 put in macoz, menuz and arngz (exit 2, its line, stdout empty); macoz 1.0.1, menuz 0.4.7, arngz 1.1.2, prez 2.5.9.
- Run 1's FAIL: ~/.cache/update-manager-core/meta-release-lts, written at 20:34:03Z by check-new-release-gtk under the desktop session's update-notifier-release.service. Its .path unit starts it when /var/lib/ubuntu-release-upgrader/release-upgrade-available changes, which it did at 20:34:00.754Z, as the run's first ssh session opened (sshd's pam_motd and its 91-release-upgrade hook, inferred). Run 2 did not write it, so the check is daily, not per login.
- Run 2's FAILs: kovacs-sysadm's live Claude Code session (claude start --name kovacs-sysadm): its transcript under ~/.config/claude/projects/-home-matts-Devel-agt-kovacs-sysadm/, and its status line's npm exec --yes -- ccstatusline@2.0.12 from ~/Devel/agt/kovacs-sysadm, by npm's own debug logs, writing ~/.cache/npm/_npx, _cacache and _logs; the two /tmp notes are the same session's. Run 1, the same commands, wrote no npm file.
- Command 2, 20:34:21Z: /var/tmp/dc-2141-sc090.qyz5IL (8 entries, 24M) and /var/tmp/dc-2141-lua.dXTRHg (3 entries, 364K) removed and read back absent. dc has nothing left on kovacs.
- The traces were read-only ssh reads, 20:35Z to 20:36Z and at 20:38:40Z, nothing written. todo 18 is archived with this record, both its steps run.
